about: Process plan for the L&L Delrin pallet inlay (Paletteneinlage, 1005337) on the shop's Haas VF-3SSYT, clamped to its table. At 600 x 400 mm it is too big for the VF-2: its 406.4 mm of Y travel can't profile both 400 mm edges (the 1/2 in end mill needs 412.7), its table is 356 mm wide, and no vise in the shop opens past 224 mm. Written by Claude from the drawing (314-092-59986-10) and the STEP model; every feature below is checked against the model by moonshot/planning/validate.py. Model frame: Z is thickness (the Z=-20 face is the bottom, datum A; the nests open from the top at Z=-0.95), Y is length (600), X is width (400, from -400 to 0). The VF-3 has no probe or tool setter in the shop record, so its X and Y are found with the edge finder and its tools measured on the presetter.

stock.material_note: As the drawing. 3/4 in plate, its two faces left as bought: the part is 19.05 thick (19.1 ±0.2)
stock.from: 3/4 in plate cut to 18 x 26 in by the supplier: wider than the band saw's 16 in

workholding.note: On a 3/4 in MDF spoilboard bolted to the table, which the through cuts run into; six step clamps on the plate's 29-30 mm margin, clear of the outline's cutter path. The outline leaves four 1 mm tabs so the part stays put; they're cut at the bench

wcs.x: the centre of the plate's length
wcs.by: edge finder in X and Y; Z touched off the top

operations.what: Drill and ream 2X Ø8.000 slip fit for the dowels
Rough and finish the 12 nest recesses 12 deep
Finish the 12 nests 25.70 x 159.00 (+0.10/0) through and their R6.4 corners, parallel 0.2 to A
Profile the outline to 600 x 400 (-0.3/-0.5) with its 45° corners and the two end notches, leaving four tabs
Undercut the two end notches' walls 20° with their R15 corners

finish.title: Cut the tabs and deburr
finish.what: Cut the four tabs and file them flush, break every sharp corner 0.2 x 45° (note 1), and countersink the back of the two dowel holes 3.0 x 45° by hand

finish.title: Check the outline, nests and dowel holes
finish.what: Check the 600 and 400 outline, the 25.70 and 159.00 nests and their 12 depth, and the Ø8.000 dowel holes with gauge pins
